title: CLA Farm-a-Bunch (NLAM)
description: A loot table for use with versions of CLA to allow pacifist farming of resources.
body:
# CLA Farm-a-Bunch
No longer actively maintained.
# Purpose
A loot table designed for use with [helmo2019](https://modrinth.com/user/helmo2019)'s [Chickens Lay Anything](https://modrinth.com/datapack/chickens-lay-anything) or my own [Art's CLA](https://modrinth.com/datapack/arts-cla), but can be use with any loot generation.

# Directions for Use
1. Install datapack.
2. If using with either Chickens Lay Anything pack, ensure this is enabled **after** CLA.

# Notes
This is a loot table only. The pools include: 1 ore block, 1 passive mob drop (uses the passive mob death loot table), and 1 piglin bertering table roll.

# Known Issues
- No known issues.

# Support and Links
## Bug Reporting and Update Notifications
To report bugs and to keep up to date with new versions and additional packs from me, please join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/bK92yTbxj3).

## Links
Check out my other packs on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/user/Artecie).

Help support ongoing development at [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/artecie) or [Ko-Fi](https://ko-fi.com/artecie).

Watch development (generally troubleshooting) and gameplay with the packs in use on my [Twitch Channel](https://twitch.tv/artecie).
